data.title: Health ministry steps up weed enforcement rules
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health has stepped up enforcement of cannabis rules, revealing the results of operations conducted since October.

data.title: Kingdom's spikers reign, sweep Vietnam
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team put on a strong performance in the championship decider of 2026 SEA V Cup first leg, decisively defeating hosts Vietnam 3-0 (25-18, 25-17, 25-14) in Hanoi on Sunday night.

data.title: Hudson demands ruthless display
data.description: Thailand will look to maintain their perfect start to the Asean Hyundai Cup when they face hosts, the Philippines, in New Clark City tonight, with head coach Anthony Hudson insisting his side must keep their concentration despite back‑to‑back victories that have already underlined their credentials.

data.title: PP rules out future cooperation with BJT
data.description: The People's Party (PP) has learned its lesson from supporting Anutin Charnvirakul's bid for the premiership, deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun said on Monday, apologising to the public and ruling out future cooperation with the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).

data.title: Korrawee to sue iLaw director
data.description: Bhumjaithai MP for Ang Thong Korrawee Prisananantakul on Monday authorised his lawyer to file a defamation complaint against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over allegations linking him to the alleged Senate election collusion case.

data.title: RFD widens Phuket land crackdown
data.description: The Royal Forestry Department (RFD) on Monday expanded its crackdown on alleged forest encroachment in Phuket, targeting eight locations as part of the government's "Phuket Model" policy to reclaim illegally occupied land.

data.title: PP accused of proxy voting
data.description: The Democrat Party on Monday called for an investigation into alleged proxy voting by People's Party councillors during a recent Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) meeting, saying it would file a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC).

data.title: PP MP, actor, answer DSI summons in forex case
data.description: People's Party (PP) list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup separately reported to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) on Monday to acknowledge charges in connection with an alleged illegal foreign exchange (forex) trading scheme.

data.title: PM blasts UN border report
data.description: Thailand has rejected a UN special rapporteur's report estimating that 650,000 Cambodians were internally displaced during recent border clashes, saying the findings relied on one-sided information and failed to include Thailand's perspective.

data.title: ONE Championship: Aliff backed for Malaysia homecoming after historic Anwar meeting
data.description: Aliff Sor Dechapan’s historic title triumph has taken him to the Malaysian Prime Minister’s Office – and growing calls for the country’s first ONE Championship world champion to fight on home soil could help shape what comes next.

data.title: Survivors recall blasts before deadly Indonesian ferry fire
data.description: SURABAYA - Survivors said on Monday they heard multiple blasts moments before an Indonesian passenger ferry caught fire, killing five people and prompting many to jump into the sea, with rescuers still searching the waters more than a day later.

data.title: Fifa's Infantino sought Trump backing after failed World Cup sell-off plan
data.description: LONDON — Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) President ⁠Gianni ⁠Infantino sought support ​from the Donald Trump administration amid mounting criticism after ​his abandoned plan to sell a stake in World Cup commercial rights, the New York Post said on Monday, citing sources familiar with the matter.

data.title: Questions swirl over Bhumjaithai unity
data.description: Although Bhumjaithai (BJT) leaders insist the party remains united, a series of recent developments has fuelled speculation over whether Thailand's dominant coalition partner is facing more than routine political tensions.

data.title: Thailand among top destinations for Koreans in drug‑trafficking cases
data.description: Thailand ranked second only to Cambodia for cases in which South Koreans were caught trying to transport illicit drugs to third countries, according to data compiled by the Foreign Affairs Ministry in Seoul and reported by a South Korean lawmaker.

data.title: Israel conveys 'concerns' to US on Gaza plan and keeps striking
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel said Monday it had conveyed concern to the United States on a plan to end the Gaza war hailed by President Donald Trump as it kept up strikes in the Palestinian territory.

data.title: Nearly 6,000 civil servants to lose jobs after exam fraud
data.description: The discovery of civil service exam fraud is expected to cost 5,925 local government employees their jobs this month, Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit said on Monday.

data.title: Patients seek answers over health data discrepancies
data.description: More than 10 people who found treatments they never received recorded in their digital health histories on Monday petitioned the Public Health Ministry, demanding answers within 15 days or they would pursue legal action.

data.title: Filipino housekeeping services win fans in Japan's growing market
data.description: Housekeeping services employing Filipino staff have gained in popularity amid growing demand in Japan for such domestic support, with one provider seeing their workforce roughly double over the past decade.

data.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' redefines responsibility
data.description: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ (2026) marks a bright morning for Tom Holland’s friendly neighbourhood superheroes. From the promotional trailers, the film is distinctly different in its visual representation than the “Home” trilogy. Yet, what makes 'Brand New Day' great is not in its departure from the others, but how it built on the legacy of the previous ones, including those of Maguire and Garfield.

data.title: Celebrating a week of Asia’s best bars
data.description: Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace successfully concluded Asia’s 50 Best Bars 2026, serving as official host partner for the second consecutive year, once again bringing the region’s most influential bar industry event to Macau and placing the city at the centre of Asia’s cocktail conversation.

data.title: Still no clearance to bring dead Thai vlogger home from Georgia
data.description: The Foreign Affairs Ministry is still awaiting clearance from police investigators in Georgia, in eastern Europe, to return the body of Thai Youtuber Hlun Solo to Thailand for funeral rites.

data.title: LEGO Art recreates Klimt's “The Kiss” in bricks
data.description: LEGO is expanding its Art collection with a brick-built tribute to Gustav Klimt's iconic “The Kiss".

data.title: Water bombers take to skies as Greece battles wildfires
data.description: KRYO PIGADI (GREECE) - Water-bombing aircraft resumed firefighting operations in Greece on Monday after winds eased, joining hundreds of firefighters battling multiple blazes that have already claimed five lives, the fire department told AFP.

data.title: Survivors recall blasts before deadly Indonesian ferry fire
data.description: SURABAYA (INDONESIA) - Survivors said on Monday they heard multiple blasts moments before an Indonesian passenger ferry caught fire, killing five passengers and prompting many to jump into the sea, with some still missing more than 24 hours later.

data.title: Malaysia wants proof southern insurgents find shelter there
data.description: Malaysia has requested evidence from Thailand to substantiate reports of armed insurgents fleeing across the border, finding refuge there, after attacks targeting security forces in the far South.

data.title: Fire destroys restaurant, spa in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A fire destroyed a three-storey building housing a resort restaurant and a massage and onsen spa in Karon district on Monday morning.

data.title: Deep South police station attacked, school closed
data.description: YALA - Gunmen fired shots at Lam Mai police station in Muang district of this southern border province on Monday morning, causing the closure of a nearby school while students were still arriving for classes.

data.title: Rescued elephant calf recovering but still has diarrhoea
data.description: KANCHANABURI - The starving elephant calf rescued near a fast-flowing stream in Sai Yok district is recovering well from her injuries and is reacting more to her surroundings, but still suffers from diarrhoea and her condition is being closely monitored by veterinarians.

data.title: Myanmar's Aung San Suu Kyi meets Red Cross official, government says
data.description: Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi met with a representative of the International Committee of the Red Cross on Monday, a spokeswoman for the Myanmar government ​said, amid concerns over the health of the 81-year-old.

data.title: Ted Lasso returns to the pitch
data.description: Apple’s biggest show was thought to be over for good, but Ted Lasso returns with its 10-episode new season on Aug 5, with one episode, followed by new episodes every Wednesday through Oct 7 on Apple TV.

data.title: Cuba state energy firm reports new nationwide blackout
data.description: HAVANA - Cuba's power grid failed Sunday, causing another nationwide blackout, a state utility said in a social media post.

data.description: SAMUT SAKHON - With her palms pressed together and her head bowed, Wassana Nak-umma vowed to give up alcohol for three months, joining millions of Thais in an abstinence campaign blending public health with spirituality.

data.description: Thailand’s national craving for sugar as a daily lifestyle is not a coincidence, as it is directly rooted in its history, shaped by royal status and cultural shifts.
